plugins.name: jotbook
plugins.description: Capture explainers as lightweight jots, curate them periodically, then pencil or ink them into long-form entries. Use /jotbook-ink (or /jot for granular actions).

skills.name: jot
skills.description: Toolkit dispatcher for `/jot` — routes user slash invocations to the appropriate jotbook skill (stage, review, ink, pencil, init). **User-triggered only; never auto-invoke.** Auto-staging is handled by `jotbook-stage`, not this skill.
skills.description_zh: 仅响应用户/jot命令，将请求分派到Jotbook暂存、评审、成文、草稿或初始化技能；自动暂存交由jotbook-stage。

skills.name: jotbook-init
skills.description: Initialize a jotbook in the current project — writes a starter `.claude/jotbook.local.md` settings file, scaffolds the directory structure, and optionally amends `.gitignore`.
skills.description_zh: 在当前项目初始化Jotbook，写入.claude/jotbook.local.md设置、搭建目录，并可选修改.gitignore。

skills.name: jotbook-ink
skills.description: Primary jotbook entry point. With no arguments, runs the guided curation session over the jot backlog. With one or more jot slugs, inks those jots into finished long-form entries (promotes any existing pencil instead of regenerating).
headings: 2. Choose path: promotion vs. fresh render
4. Fresh render path — plan and render
5. Add back-nav and a Contents TOC to the entry
skills.description_zh: 作为Jotbook成文入口，无参数时引导整理笔记积压，指定笔记slug时生成完整长文，优先提升已有草稿而非重写。

skills.name: jotbook-link
skills.description: Cross-link sweep over the inked jotbook. Walks the entries in entries_dir, surfaces pairs of topically related entries that aren't yet linked, and — on your confirmation — adds small format-appropriate links between them. Use it to connect older entries to ones inked after them. User-triggered only; never auto-invoke.
skills.description_zh: 仅用户触发时扫描已成文Jotbook条目，找出相关但未链接的内容，经确认后添加适合格式的交叉链接，连接旧文和新文。

skills.name: jotbook-pencil-review
skills.description: Review the pencil backlog and decide which provisional drafts to ink, drop, revise, edit, or keep.
skills.description_zh: 审查Jotbook临时长文草稿积压，决定成文、删除、修订、编辑或保留。

skills.name: jotbook-pencil
skills.description: Render one or more jots — or a fresh subject, which is staged as a jot first — into a provisional long-form draft (a "pencil") for later evaluation. Source jots are preserved and no cross-links are written — promotion happens later via `/jotbook-pencil-review`.
headings: Pencil a jot into a provisional draft
skills.description_zh: 将一条或多条笔记转为供后续评估的临时长文草稿，新主题先暂存为笔记，保留原笔记且不写交叉链接，之后通过pencil-review提升。

skills.name: jotbook-review
skills.description: Review the jot backlog and dispatch decisions in place — drop, merge, tweak, pencil, or ink. Surfaces overlap between related jots and flags any with a pencil already in progress.
skills.description_zh: 评审Jotbook笔记积压，识别主题重合及正在起草的条目，并执行删除、合并、微调、起草或成文的整理决定。

skills.name: jotbook-stage
skills.description: Stage a recently-discussed concept as a lightweight jot. **CRITICAL — auto-invoke this skill at the end of any turn where you delivered a substantive multi-paragraph explanation of a domain concept (a system, mechanism, piece of code, design rationale, or pattern the user might want to revisit). Don't ask permission, don't hedge, don't skip because the topic feels minor — staging is cheap and reversible; failing to capture is permanent. Stage and report in one line.** Writes a small pointer file under the configured jots directory; does not write the full entry.
skills.description_zh: 把近期讨论的领域概念暂存为轻量笔记指针，在配置的jots目录写小文件而非完整文章；原说明设计为实质多段解释后的自动捕获。

skills.name: jotbook-template
skills.description: Design a templated-HTML output for this jotbook — a full judge-panel workflow or a streamlined quick path, recommended from the project's visual richness — that produces a stylesheet, tokenized template, preview, and token-conventions doc, verifies them mechanically, and wires output_format/template_path on your sign-off. User-triggered only; never auto-invoke.
headings: 2. Build the fixed sample entry (the experiment's control)
3. Choose the path (quick vs full), and optionally take a steer
5. Write the artifacts (inert until config points at them)
skills.description_zh: 仅用户触发时为Jotbook设计模板HTML输出，按视觉需求选完整评审或快速路径，生成样式、令牌化模板、预览和约定文档，机械验证后经批准绑定输出格式与模板路径。
